## Warmup

* `Reaction`: reaction time in the task (ms)
* `Days`: day of the study (number of days of sleep deprivation)
* `Subject`: the subject ID

**Question:** Propose a model that the researchers could use to investigate the effect of sleep deprivation on reaction time.

## Warmup

* `lea`: Local Education Authority identifier
* `school`: School identifier
* `student`: Student identifier
* `score`: score on the A-level Chemistry exam
* `gcse`: score on the GCSE exam

**Question:** Propose a model that the researchers could use to model student scores on the A-level chemistry exam.
